name: obsidian-vault-copilot
description: Turn any Obsidian vault into a working system for documenting work and life — notes, tasks, decisions, documentation, standups, reports, reviews, diagrams and templates — driven from your AI coding assistant. Works with the vault you already have.

vaultName.title: Vault name
vaultName.description: Name of the Obsidian vault this plugin works with, as it appears in the vault list. Set by the vault-setup skill; the authoritative copy lives in ~/.claude/obsidian-vault-copilot/config.json.

vaultPath.title: Vault path
vaultPath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the vault.

useCases.title: Use cases
useCases.description: What the vault is used for (work, personal, study, research, writing, client work). Drives which templates and workflows are suggested.

audienceLabel.title: Report audience
audienceLabel.description: Who status updates usually go to — a manager, client, team, or just yourself. Optional.

syncMode.title: Backup and sync method
syncMode.description: How the vault is backed up: git, obsidian-sync, cloud-folder, or none. Optional — the plugin works without any sync.

sharedRepoPath.title: Shared repository path
sharedRepoPath.description: Optional local clone of a shared team or organization repository, used by the vault-share skill.
